title: Update on Global Schoolhouse Initiative Given Recent Private School Closures
what_it_is: Update on Global Schoolhouse Initiative Given Recent Private School Closures

sections.label: Global Schoolhouse initiative update
sections.summary: Question asks for update on Global Schoolhouse initiative given private school closures; 295 PEIs registered as at 2016; EDB launched initiative in 2002.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry) whether he can provide an update on the Global Schoolhouse initiative in light of the large number of private school closures in recent years.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry)
sentences.text: There has been some consolidation in the PE sector after the introduction of the PE Act.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry)
sentences.text: As at 2016, there were 295 Private Education Institutions (PEIs) registered with the Committee for Private Education, which was formerly known as the Council for Private Education.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry)
sentences.text: EDB launched the Global Schoolhouse initiative in 2002 to enhance the scope and diversity of Singapore's education landscape.

sections.label: EDB focus on industry-relevant talent
sections.summary: EDB shifted focus to working with locally-based education institutions and companies to develop industry-relevant talent and build a talent ecosystem.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry)
sentences.text: As the quality and diversity of Singapore's tertiary education landscape have increased over the years, EDB has shifted its focus towards working with locally-based education institutions and companies to develop industry-relevant talent.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry)
sentences.text: Through these efforts, we aim to build a robust ecosystem where companies can readily access, develop and deploy talent.
